title: Gross Transaction Volume
content: Gross Transaction Volume is calculated using SUM(amount) from analytics.fact_transactions. Use SUM(amount), not SUM(signed_amount), for gross transaction volume.

title: Net Transaction Flow
content: Net Transaction Flow is calculated using SUM(signed_amount) from analytics.fact_transactions. Use this metric when the user requests net transaction flow.

title: Currency Filter
content: When the user requests transactions in EUR, filter analytics.fact_transactions using currency = 'EUR'. Apply the currency filter before aggregation.

title: High-Value Transaction
content: For this banking lab, a High-Value Transaction is defined as a transaction with amount greater than 10000 and currency = 'EUR' in analytics.fact_transactions. Use amount > 10000 AND currency = 'EUR' when the user requests high-value transactions.
